name: Emergency Department admissions with diagnoses line list
notes:
This report generates a detailed list of all hospital admissions with individual diagnosis rows. Each diagnosis appears as a separate row with the diagnosis name and ICD-10 code in distinct columns, making it easy to analyze diagnosis patterns.

Key features:
- Each patient admission may have multiple rows (one per diagnosis)
- Diagnosis name and ICD-10 code are in separate columns for easy filtering and analysis
- Includes age groups for demographic analysis
- Shows the areas (location groups) where patients were admitted
- Filters by admission date within the selected date range
- Includes both primary and secondary diagnoses
- Excludes diagnoses marked as 'Disproven' or 'Recorded in error'

Use this report to:
- Identify top causes of admission by diagnosis
- Analyze diagnosis patterns by age group and sex
- Track which areas are admitting patients
- Export data for further analysis in Excel or other tools
